reason: The existing preregistration fixed the architecture, data sizes, arms and success gates but did not define the 384-way workspace value encoding or exact intermediate-state construction. This amendment closes those degrees of freedom before any completed G18P model is trained.

intermediate_states.arithmetic: four chronological accumulator states: initial x, then x after each of three +/- operations
intermediate_states.code_trace: four chronological execution states after each of four +/- program statements, starting from x=0
intermediate_states.list_reasoning: four chronological prefix reductions over exactly four values (running sum/min/max)
intermediate_states.memory_update: the four chronological values written to the exact queried key; distractor-key writes may interleave but per-key chronology is preserved

workspace_markers: four literal '~' bytes appended after the full problem statement and before the generated answer instruction; no gold state value appears in the prompt
bag_target: numerically sort the exact same four state values ascending; no information other than order is changed
final_target: strict generated string F=<integer> followed by EOS
optimization: answer-token CE + 0.35 * mean workspace CE for bag/ordered arms; final_only_control has identical workspace-head parameters but auxiliary weight exactly zero
schedule: per seed, one fixed list of 41 minibatches from the 1024 training rows; first 40 train all three arms and batch 41 is reserved solely for deterministic next-update replay verification
notes: No external weights, solver, gold answer, case object, or auxiliary target is passed into free generation. This remains a small scratch-trained mechanism pilot and cannot establish Qwen parity.
